implementation.automatic_acceptance: Only actual local structured extraction supports APPROVED/AUTOMATIC facts. Strict exact source span and USER attribution; tentative labels remain tentative. Existing manual/no-extractor fixtures remain pending.
implementation.local_model: Replaceable LocalMemoryExtractor; production GemmaMemoryExtractor uses selected warm local LiteRtLmEngine, tools disabled and isolated per-source native conversation. No hosted inference, heuristic-only extraction or fake production vectors.
implementation.scheduling: Lazy bounded child assigned before start, foreground cancellation/join and model-operation lease; unavailable/closed/unsupported engine retains pending jobs. At most4 jobs/batch;60s attempt timeout;5 failures maximum;120s fixed crash lease.
implementation.durability: Source/job atomic capture; lease/source proof checked on commit; records/job completion/index invalidation atomic. Database user_version2 retained; independently versioned extension with transactional no-backfill initialization and future/incomplete schema rejection.
implementation.privacy: Qualified source exclusion/90day clocks retained. Exact copied text ledger retains oldest clock across newIDs/restart; contradictory earlier capture clocks conflict rather than replace lineage. Latest durable tombstone time excludes every older source and derivative at claim/commit; explicit unlocked history remains allowed.
implementation.sensitivity: Eligible save independent of disclosure unlock; restricted automatic facts accepted. Store/context rereads and live MemoryTurnContext unlock fence, UI compositional removal, lock observer synchronously revokes queued speech. All sensitive-bound assistant stream/complete/controller/history/delivery copies generic before cached frozen surfaces; raw permitted live TTS remains fenced.
implementation.index_jobs: Canonical mutation stores coalesced pending generation index jobs. No vector/hybrid index implementation or fake completion; canonical lexical read continues until goal3.
implementation.release_reachability: Keep on directly instrumented new policy/model/fence types. New Android delivery regression uses kept target-APK policy bridge, avoiding direct test DEX references to unkept frozen SpeechDelivery DTO names.
implementation.documentation: Append accepted privacy qualification, extraction implementation facts and unverified/reduced behavior; previous failures retained.

new_regressions.Android: Additive test37 plus paired manifest; SQLite close/reopen/lease recovery/source mismatch/stale commit, automatic ordinary+sensitive save, locked reread/context/fence, generic controller/history/delivery/diagnostics, erasure suppression across copy IDs with explicit history, version2 extension creation without backfill and future/missing extension rejection. Controlled decoder fixture, not actual model inference.

remaining_risks_and_reduced_behavior: Uncompiled/unexecuted candidate; source reasoning and integrity checks are not runtime validation. Independent source review and exact remote full CI still required before acceptance or goal3.

Source support is deliberately conservative: rejects quoted/indirect/question/hypothetical sources and exact stored wording only. Automatic acceptance recall is reduced; extraction quality/capacity on actual selected Gemma weights unmeasured.

Sensitivity classifier upgrades model labels with conservative text detectors. Semantic classification coverage is not proven; raw user sensitive voice text beyond these detectors may remain in frozen history surfaces. This is an explicit qualification gap for independent review, not a full UI/model sensitivity guarantee.

Sensitive-bound assistant answers are generically retained in chat and voice history even while unlocked because frozen cached history surfaces cannot revoke rich copies. Permitted live guarded TTS and direct unlocked memory views preserve current disclosure.

Erasure barrier conservatively suppresses all pre-erase retained source jobs, including unrelated facts. Fresh post-barrier finalized statements may establish new evidence; exact older text cannot reset original time. No semantic embedding suppression claim.

Idle extraction starts only when eligible warm Gemma exists at foreground idle boundaries; no model auto-load or unbounded periodic retry. Failed/unavailable pending work waits for another eligible boundary.
Index jobs are durable invalidation intentions, not yet a consumed vector index; goal3 must implement genuine indexing/retrieval before such qualification.
Delivery test bridge uses controlled10-frame fixture and exercises real sanitization/controller persistence; it does not establish acoustic delivery or physical playback correctness.
